title: mine pump (running)

sections.heading: How to use
sections.text: Cost and limits: It is mended and working; there is nothing more to do to it.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A hand pump on an iron collar over the mine shaft, worked by a long oak rod. The lower level lives or drowns by it.
